title: Connect your AI app
description: {{product}} works inside the AI app you already use. Add it once, then ask about your courses in plain language.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.background: Your AI app starts {{product}} in the background when it needs it. There's nothing to keep open.
howItWorks.local: Your data stays on this computer until your AI app reads it to answer your question.
howItWorks.once: You only need to set this up once for each app.
howItWorks.moved: If you move {{product}} to another folder, copy the setup here again — the path changes with it.

steps.label: Steps for {{app}}
steps.openJson: Open the configuration file at this location. Create it if it isn't there yet.
steps.openToml: Open this TOML file. Create it if it isn't there yet.
steps.openTomlNoPath: Open the app's TOML configuration file.
steps.pasteJson: Paste in this snippet. If the file already has settings, merge the two.
steps.pasteToml: Add these lines to the file.
steps.restart: Save the file, then fully quit the app and open it again.

tryIt.title: Try it
tryIt.promptWeek: What's happening in my courses this week?
tryIt.promptPlan: Make me a study plan for the next two weeks.

empty.title: No setup steps available
empty.description: {{product}} couldn't prepare the setup steps for your AI app. Try again in a moment.

noteCodes.works_on_all_claude_plans: Works on every Claude plan, including Free.
noteCodes.admins_may_disable_extensions: On Team, Enterprise and Education plans an admin can turn extensions off.
noteCodes.needs_paid_claude_plan: Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan (Pro or higher).
noteCodes.codex_config_shared_with_chatgpt_desktop: The ChatGPT desktop app (Work/Codex mode) reads the same ~/.codex/config.toml.
noteCodes.codex_plus_and_edu_documented: Documented for ChatGPT Plus and higher, and for Edu.
noteCodes.free_go_undocumented: Support on the Free and Go plans isn't documented.
noteCodes.restart_client_after_change: Quit and reopen the app after changing its config.
noteCodes.custom_data_dir: This setup includes PAGELAMP_HOME because {{product}} uses a custom data folder.
noteCodes.generic_stdio_client: Any other AI app that supports local (stdio) MCP servers works too: adapt the command, arguments and environment to its config format.

quarantine.title: If macOS blocks {{product}}
quarantine.body: This beta isn't notarized by Apple yet. If macOS won't open {{product}}, or stops it when your AI app starts it: open {{product}} once, then go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click “Open Anyway”.
